t: The Bug That Hid Behind a Mac's '∂' Symbol
s: This article details the challenge of cross-platform keyboard shortcut compatibility, specifically adapting Pipulate's hotkeys for macOS by mapping Control+Alt to Control+Option, while maintaining a single demo path. It covers platform detection implementation, branch management, and the eventual merge to main to enable Mac auto-updates.
sub: Mac vs. Windows/Linux keyboard modifier key differences (Command/Option vs. Control/Alt)
Implementing platform detection in a web application using JavaScript
Git branching and merging strategy for isolated feature development and deployment
Adapting hotkey logic based on detected OS for consistent user experience
